_comment: PortfoliFLOW UI Theme — centralised colour and font parameters for the PyQt6 GUI. Loaded by gui/theme.py via core/ui_theme.py.

text._comment: primary is the neutral high-emphasis colour since UX A-0 (design parameters §3.2); the brand red is accent.primary and is used for the one primary action, the active navigation marker, focus and the logo only.

font.family: IBM Plex Sans, Inter, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif
font.family_mono: IBM Plex Mono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

semantic._comment_table_bg_dark: Dark-theme variants used by ADR-0062 heatmap tinting on performance columns (Excess, Alpha, IR, ...). Desaturated dark green / dark red read as a perceptible tint on the canonical #0A0A0A background without overpowering cell text.

shadow._comment: Elevation. panel is the drop shadow under a menu, the activity panel, the planning-desk popover, the SAA drawers and the command palette; scrim is the backdrop behind a modal. Both are whole CSS values, not colours, so a stylesheet never restates a blur radius.

accessible._comment: Overrides applied by the shell under data-a11y="on" (design parameters §2.11); the remapping rule lives in the component layer, not here.

pf._comment: Web-shell tokens emitted under --pf-* by scripts/generate_theme_artifacts.py. Reserved for shell-level tokens (sidebar widths, accent overlays, status-bar heights); the per-component stepper palette was retired with the single-button Data Import refactor (sub-stream 6F).
